behaviorFixed.rule: Split p/small paragraph text into direct AX StaticText text/span/text fragments only when the DOM has exactly one direct span, the leading direct text ends with sentence punctuation, the trailing text starts lowercase, and the AX children mirror the direct DOM text order.

does not apply to multi-span paragraphs or ordinary inline spans without a sentence boundary
